title: Of Human Criteria and Automatic Metrics: A Benchmark of the Evaluation of Story Generation
reasoning: The paper introduces a set of 6 human criteria for evaluating story generation (relevance, coherence, empathy, surprise, engagement, and complexity) and a dataset (HANNA) for meta-evaluation. These criteria focus on storytelling quality and reader experience, but do not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics in the generated content.
